params.body:
"Delen met een link (0 actief)" sat in a fold on the Bouwsoft page, because that page was once the only one a shared link opened. Its text still said "Met de link zie je Bouwsoft en Netwerk", while a link now opens Bespreken, Netwerk, Bouwsoft and Medewerkers and lands on Bespreken.

- New page `Delen met een link` at `/delen` (`ShareLinks` component), linked from the account menu for everybody signed in, above Gebruikers.
- Text: "Met de link opent iemand zonder account Bespreken, Netwerk, Bouwsoft en Medewerkers, en kan er ook noteren. Niet het dagrapport, de fiches of de ploeg."
- Same form, one-time link display and active-link list as before; `createLink`/`revokeLink` moved out of `Explore`.
- The notice a link visitor sees on Bouwsoft now names the same four pages.
- Somebody on a link gets 403 on `/delen`; existing links keep working.

Tests: 339 pass, pint clean; ExploreLinkTest covers the new page, the menu entry, the form gone from Bouwsoft, and the 403 for a link visitor. Checked in the browser: menu entry, making a link.
